no_verdict: Sides are named as built. No rule, band or score toward a reuse verdict; the reading is descriptive: on the built pair, does the share separate the sides, and in the prior's direction or steering's.

sources.prior_bar, smallest_gap, inert, gain_flo: E151 experiments/disagreeing_pairs/results/predictions.json thresholds, unchanged (E151's controls run unchanged)
sources.build_margin 0.6: E151 Amendment 1's common_prior_min: the 0.5-decade prior bar plus the 0.1 smallest gap as margin (5.91e-5 x 10^0.6 = 2.35e-4 against copy); the same margin is applied below the prior-matched cipher (3.73e-5 / 10^0.6 = 9.36e-6)

definitions.prior, prior call, steering, share, call: E151's, unchanged and applied by its rules.py (pair_calls, reading, CALL): the prior is keydep.geo_rate of steering.load_task(windows_<map>_trained.pt).lp0; the prior call is +1 / -1 by the gap's sign iff |gap| >= 0.5 decades, else 0; steering is E149's strength-1 pooled share; the share is E136's Job.trained on the saved bf16 update; a reading on three seeds a side 'separates' iff |gap| >= 0.1 and |gap| > the larger within-side range; 'opposite' iff the prior call is nonzero and steering separates with the other sign; on an opposite pair the reading is 'follows prior', 'follows steering', 'neither' (the share reads 'does not' or 'inert') or 'unreadable'

constructions, in order.freq64, freq32, freq16 (built new; partn: the K pool words (word-like ranks 0-2999 minus the 128 keys and the half-known map's values) with the largest minimum over the 128 keys of W0's per-key geometric-mean P(v | M key); each key one of them, by a seed-0 shuffle of the keys, word j % K for the j-th shuffled key (128 / K keys a word, no key-to-word link); pairs.frequent_words, pairs.balanced
constructions, in order.neighbour (built reuse; partner the prio: each key's word-like token (ladder.plain_token) with the highest cosine of W0's input embeddings, the key itself and every other key excluded; pairs.neighbours

definitions.build check: stage 0, from W0 only, before any fine-tune: the realised prior gap (reuse minus new, decades) must be <= -build_margin (pairs.prior_ok): the prior points to the side built new by at least 0.6 decades. Stage 1, before any share is read: the constructions that passed, in order, each fine-tuned (3 seeds) and read by strength-1 steering; the first whose E151 condition is 'opposite' is the pair (pairs.first_built) and no later one is trained
definitions.score: on the pair: E151's rules.reading with its condition; also reported, the share call (separates / does not / inert / unreadable) and its gap

stop_rules.stage 0 controls: E151's run.controls, unchanged: any miss exits 1 before any table
stop_rules.stage 0 tables: a table whose zero update does not read 0 exits 1; no construction passing its prior bar exits 1 before any training: the cell closes, 'could not be built with this apparatus'
stop_rules.stage 1: a construction with a seed under the gain floor stops training that construction (its steering is unreadable, so its condition is 'condition not met'); none 'opposite' exits 1 before any share: the cell closes, 'could not be built'; a projected job time over 25 min after four states exits 1
stop_rules.stage 2: none; the reading is reported as it comes, 'unreadable' included

P1.claim: a pair is built (stage 1 finds a construction reading 'opposite')
P1.basis: generic words should put the frequent-word prior well over 2.35e-4; the 4-word shuffled twin steers at about 0.57 and 128-word ciphers at 0.08-0.12, so 64 words should sit well under copy's 0.56

P2.claim: the pair is the first construction tried, freq64
P2.basis: the 64th most generic word may fall under the prior bar

P3.claim: the share follows steering: the side built to reuse reads at least 0.1 higher
P3.basis: every no-link 96-key map reads 0.23-0.38 against copy's 0.77 (E147); against it, prior_vs_share's line puts a 1e-3 prior near 0.8 (rival a)

expected.zero update (stage 0): steering change at strength 1 <= 1e-9, steering path gain 0, share gain 0 and share unreadable
expected.positive control (stage 0, saved states): copy / prior-matched cipher shares 0.771 / 0.378 and steering 0.560 / 0.115, each within 1e-4 of E147 / E149; condition 'condition not met' (prior gap 0.20 decades, steering separates)
expected.refit control: prior-matched cipher seed 0 share within 0.0088 of E147's
expected.do-nothing pair: steering unreadable, condition 'condition not met': never built
expected.frequent-word priors: 3e-4 to 3e-3, lowest at K = 64; each table's zero update reads 0
expected.neighbour prior: 1e-6 to 3e-5; it may miss its bar (9.36e-6)
expected.steering of the new states: freq64 0.15-0.30, rising as K falls; neighbour 0.3-0.6; gain 5-15 (every 96-key map read 9.5-21)

blind_to: The steering and share calls compare three seeds a side, so a construction's systematic confound (several keys per word in the frequent-word map; near-copies in the neighbour copy) is read as part of the side. The prior is one value a map. One pair: the reading says what the share does on this pair, not on a family of pairs.
seen_before_filing: The partners' shares, priors and steering (copy, prior-matched cipher: E147, E149, prior_vs_share) were seen; the new sides' priors, steering and shares were not (no model was loaded for this design; the tokenizer only, to check the keys).

edge_cases_checked_before_filing.how: tests/test_disagreeing_pairs2.py runs each line against pairs.py and E151's rules.py
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.none 'opposite': first_built returns None: stage 1 stops, exit 1
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.new side with a seed under the gain floo: its steering seeds hold nan: E151's call reads 'unreadable', condition 'condition not met', next construction
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.do-nothing pair (zero updates both sides: gain 0 is under the floor, so steering is nan on every seed: 'unreadable', condition 'condition not met', never built
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.share unreadable on the pair: reading 'unreadable', reported, no prediction P3 true

what changes what we do: Follows steering or neither: part 2 has a pair where the share carries something the prior does not, and writes the paragraph from it. Follows the prior: part 2 writes that on direction the share adds nothing beyond the prior. No pair built: the cell closes as not buildable with this apparatus.
